This project will be focused in Martin Hall and Andrews Science Building. The following highlights areas of work on the project. Replace all existing windows Replace doors as needed in Martin Hall and Andrews Science Building which should match other doors in the building Repair foundation/drainage issues around Martin Hall Review and Repair/Replace martin Hall roof and drains/scuppers Buildings will remain operational during construction

title: Design for UTS Multiple Building Envelope Repairs
short_description: Envelope repairs for two university buildings including windows, doors, roof, and foundation drainage.
project_scope: Repair and replacement of exterior building system components at Martin Hall and Andrews Science Building on the University of Tennessee Southern campus. Scope includes replacement of all existing windows, replacement of doors as needed to match existing building doors, repair of foundation and drainage issues around Martin Hall, and review and repair or replacement of the Martin Hall roof including drains and scuppers. Buildings will remain operational during construction.
services: Architecture services; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil engineering; planning/master planning; mechanical engineering; structural engineering; utility engineering; stormwater; urban studies/planning/design.

- University project, which is generally of some interest to sbp.
- However, scope is mainly building envelope repair and refurbishment, not a structurally complex or innovative load-bearing structure.
- No long spans, special structures, bridge works, stadium elements, or architecturally demanding new building components are indicated.
- Structural engineering is listed, but the described tasks focus primarily on windows, doors, roof repairs, and drainage.
- Limited strategic relevance compared with sbp's core focus on bridges, long-span roofs, and special lightweight structures.
